name: Aether Industries Ltd
description: AboutIncorporated in 2013, Aether Industries Limited is a manufacturer of specialty chemicals. The company is sole Indian manufacturer for chemicals such as 4-(2-Methoxyethyl) Phenol (4MEP), and 3-Methoxy-2-Methylbenzoyl Chloride (MMBC), Thiophene-2-Ethanol (T2E), Ortho Tolyl Benzo Nitrile (OTBN), N-Octyl-D-Glucamine, Delta-Valerolactone, and Bifenthrin Alcohol.[1]Key PointsBusiness Segments[1][2]a) Contract / Exclusive Manufacturing (46% in FY26 vs 31% in FY25):[3]The company produces products for its customers under contractual supply agreements that can be either short-term or long-term, and may be exclusive or non-exclusive in nature. It has entered into long-term take-or-pay contracts with global clients such asBaker Hughes, SEQENS, and Saudi Aramco.Read MoreWebsiteBSENSE
